name: mojulo
description: The mojulo plugin, published by Franz Ombico from the zombico/mojulo repository: a local MCP server that turns Claude into a 3D creative studio.

plugins.name: mojulo
plugins.description: Turn Claude into a 3D creative studio: 3D objects, characters, environments, interactive worlds and even playable games, made by asking and kept on your machine. Play them in the browser or on your desktop, print them, or open them in Godot, Unity, Unreal or Blender. No account, no external telemetry.
